title: Connect Slackbot to other apps with MCP | Slack

facts.fact: Developers, either third-party or at the user's organization, can add MCP servers to the Slack apps they build.
facts.quote: Developers (either third-party developers or developers at your organization) can add MCP servers to Slack apps they build.

facts.fact: When a user installs an app, Slackbot gains access to a set of tools that the developer configured to take actions in that app.
facts.quote: When you install an app, Slackbot gains access to a set of tools configured by the developer to take actions in that app
